<thought>Construct the combined topology using the series subnetworks identified from the measurements. Subnet 1 provides two series resistors between A and X1 (2.222 Ω and 4.445 Ω). Subnet 2 provides three series resistors between X1 and X2 (5 Ω, 4.444 Ω, 8.889 Ω). Subnet 3 provides four series resistors between X2 and X3 (5 Ω, 10 Ω, 15 Ω, 20 Ω). Subnet 4 supplies a single resistor of 50 Ω between X3 and B (the measured A‑B resistance of 125 Ω requires this value). All resistor identifiers are made unique by prefixing with the subnet label. The resulting JSON topology is ready for validation.</thought>
